Kyiv, Ukraine — A Russian jet-powered drone strikes one of Kyiv’s bridges. If Moscow succeeds in seriously damaging Kyiv’s bridges, it could create a logistical nightmare for the city of 3 million people, whose crossings over the Dnipro were last destroyed on a large scale as Nazi German forces retreated in 1943. More than a third of residents live on the left bank, while much of the city’s employment and infrastructure is concentrated on the right. — Photograph: Valentyn Ogirenko/Reuters

Grand Island, Nebraska — Natalie Harp, an executive assistant to Donald Trump, brings out an executive order for him to sign during a campaign rally at Pinnacle Bank Expo Center in Grand Island. At the rally on Monday night, Trump told supporters he hoped to see a ‘tremendous victory’ in the fast-approaching November midterm elections. He then suggested high prices due to the war with Iran were a ‘small price to pay for keeping the world safe – keeping our country safe’. — Photograph: Kent Nishimura/AFP/Getty Images

Asira al-Qibliya, West Bank — Palestinian farmers try to extinguish fires on their land after Israeli soldiers fired teargas at them as they harvested their olives, resulting in the dry fields catching fire, in the village of Asira al-Qibliya. Armed Israeli settlers beat Jaafar Ashtiyeh, the photographer who took this image, in the presence of Israeli soldiers, hospitalising him, as he covered the settler violence against the olive farmers. Ashtiyeh, a 58-year-old veteran photographer for AFP in Palestine, was assaulted by a group of settlers despite him being marked as press. — Photograph: Jaafar Ashtiyeh/AFP/Getty Images

Source: The Guardian — Photos of the Day

Aqraba, West Bank — Palestinian men run after Israeli forces open fire while they are being chased away from picking olives in Aqraba in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. Every year, settlers attack Palestinian farmers trying to harvest their olives – an economic lifeline for the beleaguered Palestinian economy – with few legal consequences. This harvest season has been particularly violent as the Israeli elections approach at the end of the month. — Photograph: John Wessels/AFP/Getty Images
